items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Louis (Armstrong) was there too. He was...just formed his new sextet with Jack Teagarden and Earl Hines and Arvell Shaw and I think it was Zutty (Singleton) on drums.

ctx.x: So you started working there in Detroit, your first job with the Dizzy Gillespie Band.

Yeah! That was quite an experience because in the atmosphere...Louis (Armstrong) was there too. He was...just formed his new sextet with Jack Teagarden and Earl Hines and Arvell Shaw and I think it was Zutty (Singleton) on drums. And one day Dizzy'd be on the radio and said, "We got the new music," and then another day Louis'd be on and say, "Well look, Bebop ain't this..." And I was confused, "What they doin'?," on the radio, you know. But I'm sure that they loved each other, you know what I mean, shoot. But…
